gloss: to swell; to become puffy; to be swollen

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: むくんでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to swell; to become puffy; to be swollen
definitions.explanation: To become swollen or puffy, typically referring to body parts due to water retention, fatigue, or medical conditions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧むくんで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

examples.english: Sometimes my face is puffy in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塩分|えんぶん}→塩分：09945_enbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{摂|と}り→摂る：29372_toru⟧すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧むくみやすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you consume too much salt, your body becomes prone to swelling.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). No pair verb.

ASPECT (ている):
むくんで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates a current state of being swollen.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧むくむ (legs swell)
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧むくむ (face becomes puffy)
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧むくむ (hands swell)
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧むくむ (body swells)

RELATED NOUN:
⟦むくみ→むくみ：07277_mukumi⟧ - swelling, puffiness, edema
- ⟦むくみ→むくみ：07277_mukumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to reduce swelling)
- ⟦むくみ→むくみ：07277_mukumi⟧⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧ (swelling prevention)

MEDICAL CONTEXT:
⟦むくみ→むくみ：07277_mukumi⟧ is the common word for what is medically called ⟦{浮腫|ふしゅ}→浮腫：22546_fushu⟧ (edema). Common causes include standing for long periods, high salt intake, and poor circulation.
